doesNotModel: No damping at note-off: a note rings until its string is touched again or its own losses and the palm take it ([stac] and lifted fingers cannot be heard).
Each string has one pluck point, its hand's (set at create): a per-touch pluck point is not modelled.
24 partials per string: the low E reaches about 2 kHz, the high E about 8 kHz.
The back, ribs and neck are rigid; bracing is folded into the plate's stiffness; radiation is monopole-weighted with no directivity.
Linear: no tension modulation, no fret buzz.
High frequencies cross the bridge weakly (the band-rising bridge rate is a fit, not a law): the guitar is warm.
Harmonics are played as ordinary plucks.

The bow: a slow attack (0.25-0.7 s before Helmholtz motion locks), secondary slips below speed 0.4, pitch flattening at heavy force; a velocity source with no bow mass, hair compliance or width, no torsion; one bow per string at one point.
It is a guitar-shaped Ariadne body, not a model of any particular guitar.

kinds.cost: the heaviest World: 14 board bodies plus about 2.5 wires and a hammer per key, each wire with 14 bridge edges. Measured in node (wasm, 128-frame quanta, a 2019 8-core i9 laptop): 1 key 2.4x real time, 4 keys 1.1x, 8 keys 0.63x, 13 keys 0.41x, 25 keys 0.22x, 37 keys 0.15x. Live play wants few keys (or a bigger machine); scores render offline
doesNotModel: One transverse polarization: no horizontal string motion, no longitudinal waves or phantom partials, no tension modulation (the strings are linear).
No sympathetic strings beyond the keys strung: with the pedal down the rest of the scale does not ring along.
The action is a throw: no key, wippen, escapement dynamics, repetition lever, key bounce or action noise; a key cannot be re-thrown while its felt still presses (refused and counted).
The board is flat and the frame rigid: no crown, downbearing, taper, rim, lid or frame resonances; board modes above 3 kHz are sampled every 4th.
Radiation is baffled and diagonal in the modes; heard at two far-field points, dry, with no room.
The felt is a power law with relaxation; its parameters away from C4 are design-hypotheses, as is the damper away from A#4.
Pitch is set per string, alone: where a partial sits on a board resonance the coupled pitch moves (C4 -5.6 cents); the piano is not re-tuned after it is built.
It is a piano-shaped Ariadne world, not a model of the Estonia or of any particular piano.
